# S0123: xCmd

<a id="s0123"></a>

Type: tool  
ATT&CK: [S0123](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0123)  

[xCmd](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0123) is an open source tool that is similar to [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) and allows the user to execute applications on remote systems.
